```{r}
library(readr)
spotifyDat <- read_csv("spotifyDat Fall26.csv")

library(tidyverse)
library(viridis)
data(mtcars)
library(palmerpenguins)
data(penguins)
```
Code to be Fixed
```{r}
ggplot(spotifyDat, aes(popularity, tempo, fill = danceability)) + geom_point() + scale_fill_viridis()
```

```{r}
penguinsLong <- penguins |> pivot_longer(cols = c("measurements"), names_from = "bill_length_mm", "bill_depth_mm", "flipper_length_mm", "body_mass_g", values_to = "value")
```

```{r}
penguins<- penguins |> mutate(penguins$massLbs = body_mass_g/453.6)
```

Solutions
```{r}
ggplot(spotifyDat, aes(popularity, tempo, color = danceability)) + geom_point() + scale_color_viridis()
```

```{r}
penguinsLong <- penguins |> pivot_longer(cols = c("bill_length_mm", "bill_depth_mm", "flipper_length_mm", "body_mass_g"), names_to = "measurements", values_to = "value")
```

```{r}
penguins<- penguins |> mutate(massLbs = body_mass_g/453.6)
```
